status: Recorded after all collection and inspection of aggregate/early results, before final model fitting and held-out predictive evaluation. Not an original preregistration.
relationship_to_pilot_plan: Extends final_analysis_plan.json to Claude and tolerant solution_mention_v1 scoring. Original plans, collection manifest and raw logs remain unchanged.
primary_regression: Pooled binomial GLM on 3000 answers: frozen full predictors plus Gemini and Claude identity indicators (GPT-OSS reference); puzzle-clustered covariance over 1000 puzzles. No interactions or predictor selection.
regression_gate: At least 50 successes and 50 failures in each model; full column rank; converged finite estimates and covariance; no perfect separation warning. If unsupported, report the reason without silently dropping predictors or changing the specification.
predictor_recipe: data/experiments/one_move_v1/feature_recipe.json; use its frozen full predictors in original rating/count units for XGBoost. Numeric regression scaling stays unchanged.
prediction: Separate XGBClassifier per deployment; no model identity predictor within a per-model classifier.
training: Fit each classifier on the fixed 800 training puzzle IDs only; require at least 30 successes and 30 failures. No hyperparameter search, feature selection, early stopping, validation-set selection or test-set tuning. The pilot 100 are included in those 800.
freeze_before_test: Save native UBJ model, exact parameter dictionary, feature names, 800 training IDs and model hash before predicting held-out outcomes. Reuse the frozen model on rerun.
evaluation: Evaluate once on the fixed 200 held-out puzzles per model. Cache predictions and metrics tied to model/input hashes; reruns verify and reuse the cached evaluation. Report accuracy/Wilson95, balanced accuracy, ROC AUC when defined, Brier score, confusion counts and training-majority baseline.
feature_importance: Report training gain importance for each feature; descriptive and not causal or proof of held-out importance. Show this ensemble summary instead of presenting a single tree as the entire XGBoost model.
pilot_results: Unchanged: GPT-OSS 35/100, Gemini 53/100. Early trees are descriptive single CARTs, not XGBoost.
scoring: solution_mention_v1; post-hoc scoring amendment applies identically to all deployments. Strict results retained for descriptive sensitivity comparison.
descriptive_outputs: Overall Wilson intervals, rating-band accuracy, strict versus tolerant counts. No additional model fitting or hypothesis selection based on these tables.
interpretation: Primary rating test is inherited from original plan. Model/theme contrasts and deployment differences are secondary associations. Holdout is reserved for predictive evaluation, not for the pooled association regression.
